how_to_apply: The notification describes an offline process. The steps below follow the notification and its application form.
Read the notification and confirm that you meet the qualification, experience and age conditions for the post. Confirm that you hold a valid CRR/RCI or equivalent registration where applicable.
Fill in the prescribed application form (one application for each post). Affix a recent passport-size photograph and self-attest it, and tick any one location in the form.

Prepare a Demand Draft of Rs. 300/- per post, drawn in favour of the Director, Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech & Hearing Disabilities (Divyangjan), payable at Mumbai. Write your name and the post applied for on the backside of the Demand Draft.

Attach self-attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates/proof of age, experience/CRR No., and other relevant documents related to category, salary drawn, disability and so on. Employed candidates should attach a No Objection Certificate from the employer.
Sign the application. Write the Name of the Post Applied for and the Advertisement Number on the top of the envelope. Use separate envelopes if applying for more than one post.

Send the application by Registered/Speed Post/Courier to: The Director, Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech & Hearing Disabilities (Divyangjan), K.C. Marg, Bandra Reclamation, Bandra (W), Mumbai – 400050. It must reach within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News.

The notification does not mention an online application link or portal. It asks for the application in the prescribed format, duly signed, to be sent to the Director by Registered/Speed Post/Courier. Postal delays are the candidate's responsibility, as the Institute will not be responsible for them.
important_instructions: The contractual appointment will be on a full-time basis. The candidate will not be permitted to take up any other commercial assignment during the period of engagement. The engagement may be terminated by the Competent Authority at any time without assigning any reason by giving 30 days' notice. A consultant/contractual staff member who wishes to resign may do so by giving 30 days' advance notice or remuneration in lieu thereof. Engagement will be governed by the rules, regulations, terms and conditions of the Institute as currently in force or as may be framed, amended, altered or extended from time to time by the DEPwD/Institute/NBER-RCI. Paid leave, wherever admissible, may be granted as per the provisions of the relevant scheme, NBER guidelines and the applicable rules/policy of the concerned Institute/CRC. The term of appointment shall ordinarily be for an initial period not exceeding 3 years, extendable up to a maximum of 5 years. Extension beyond 3 years requires approval of the Governing Council of the Institute/Executive Council of the Institute/CRC. In no case shall the engagement be extended beyond 5 years. For Group 'A' posts, the contract may be renewed for a total duration of up to 3 years based on annual performance appraisal initiated by the Director, AYJNISHD(D), and reviewed by the Joint Secretary and Chairperson, Executive Council of the Institute. For Group 'B' and 'C' posts, the contract may be renewed for a total duration of up to 3 years by the Director, AYJNISHD(D), based on annual performance appraisal and recommendation of the committee constituted by the Director.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech and Hearing Disabilities (Divyangjan) (AYJNISHD(D)), Mumbai.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AYJNISHD(D) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 68 vacancies available across various posts including Assistant Professor, Lecturer, Clinical Assistant, Consultant, and other allied rehabilitation and administrative roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates must send their duly filled application forms by post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: An application fee of Rs. 300/- is applicable for all candidates, payable via Demand Draft drawn in favour of the Director, AYJNISHD(D), Mumbai.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration ranges from Rs. 18,000/- to Rs. 75,000/- depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The contractual appointment is initially for a period not exceeding 3 years, which is extendable up to a maximum of 5 years.

faq.question: Q8. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to The Director, Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech and Hearing Disabilities (Divyangjan), K.C. Marg, Bandra Reclamation, Bandra (W), Mumbai - 400050.

faq.question: Q9. Is RCI registration mandatory for clinical/rehabilitation posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates should possess a valid CRR Registration Number of RCI, New Delhi, or equivalent registration, as on the last date for submission of application.

faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and application format from the official website at http://ayjnihd.nic.in.
